relationships.subject: PECS-101
relationships.evidence_quote: PECS-101 (1 mg/kg) administered along with PTX treatment caused a long-lasting relief of the mechanical and cold allodynia

relationships.subject: PECS-101
relationships.evidence_quote: PECS-101 also decreased PTX-induced increase in Tnf, Il6, and Aif1 (Iba-1) gene expression in the DRGs

relationships.subject: PECS-101
relationships.evidence_quote: the effects of PECS-101 on the relief of PTX-induced mechanical and cold allodynia were not found in macrophage-specific PPARγ-deficient mice

key_findings: PECS-101 given with paclitaxel gives lasting relief of mechanical and cold allodynia via PPARγ, not CB1/CB2.
Effect absent in macrophage-specific PPARγ-deficient mice.
